label: A first unmoved mover first in being is first in PRIOR_1: none other is PRIOR_1 to it
paraphrase: OPEN sense bridge PRIOR_4 to PRIOR_1, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every f, if f is a first mover moved by none and nothing other than f is prior to it in being (PRIOR_4), then nothing other than f is prior to it in act in a respect (PRIOR_1, the PriorSimply of DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY): every y with PriorSimply y f is f. It is restricted to first unmoved movers that are first in being and is not a general inclusion of PRIOR_1 in PRIOR_4; a general inclusion is excluded by reciprocal cross-respect moving if PRIOR_1 comes from actual moving in any respect (6ca87431). It is the weakest bridge the pure-act derivation of this batch uses. Lane B's 2026-11-18 second test named this crux: 'nothing other than the first being is prior to it in act in any respect'. Rival on file: the firstWayDoesNotYieldPureAct model of the FirstMoverPureAct result, where a first unmoved mover is in potency to a respect in which it moves nothing and another being, in act in that respect, is PRIOR_1 to it; whether such a being is also prior in being is what the bridge settles.
